summary: All 59 files in Complexitylib/RationalHitting/ and its subdirectories contain formal mathematical definitions, theorems, and proofs. The files follow the project's three-layer architecture: Defs.lean files provide core types and definitions (e.g., Formula, Output, evalMatrix?), Internal/ files contain proof internals and helper lemmas (e.g., affine realization, binary arithmetic, Wronskian, stack compilation), and surface files (Evaluation.lean, PolynomialTime.lean) state public theorems with proofs from Internal. Every inspected file has executable Lean content — inductive types, defs, lemmas with proofs, and theorem statements. No file is a pure import aggregator. Per FILTER-007, pure import aggregators would be navigation data, but these files all contain mathematical declarations. Per FILTER-002/004, hard exclusion requires prover-aware evidence of no formal math content, which is contradicted by direct inspection. Per FILTER-025, the default disposition is retain.
